keywords_glossary.role: Early guard that exits on non-positive inputs before computing. In production, it prevents silent negative amounts in billing or KPIs.

formatting_mechanics.indentation: Use strictly 4 spaces per block level; never use tab characters.
formatting_mechanics.line_breaks: Place the docstring on the first line of the function body and keep guard and main return on separate lines.
formatting_mechanics.punctuation: Put a space after commas and around binary operators (`<=`, `*`, `->`), with no space before `:`.
formatting_mechanics.documentation_standard: Add a PEP 257 triple-double-quoted docstring (`"""`) and explicit parameter/return type annotations.

formatting_mechanics.indentation: Indent 4 spaces per block and 4 spaces inside multi-line list comprehensions.
